introHtml: For buyers who need reusable bottles that are as easy to clean as they are to store, custom dishwasher safe collapsible bottles combine convenience with sustainability. Made from food-grade silicone, these bottles flatten when empty for compact storage, then pop back into shape for hydration on the go. The dishwasher-safe feature saves time for busy teams, whether you're outfitting a corporate wellness program or giving out branded gear at a trade show. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or pad printing for a lasting impression.
